Creates the Student, the Admission and the first Enrollment and moves the application to ADMITTED — all in one transaction, so a failure anywhere leaves the applicant exactly as it was. The applicant row is locked before its state is read, so two registrars admitting at the same moment produce one student and one clean conflict naming it. A person who is already a student here is refused: returning students are readmitted against the existing identity, which is a separate operation.
